items.text: With a monetary donation you can help universally and give Agnes Link and A-CT the possibility to use funds independent of location and time.
With your know-how you can make an important contribution to the numerous projects.
With a donation in kind (agricultural equipment, simple machines etc.) you have another possibility to support.
In Germany you can get a donation certificate.

blocks.text: For more information you can also call +49 160 90800222
HELP in order that we can HELP young people in Africa.

blocks.markdown:
Thank you so much for supporting this vision\
Your support is highly appreciated\

Keep supporting us\
